member.name: T:KeshavSingh.Storage.DynamicObjectStore
member.summary: The that AddKeshavStorage registers. It reads the current settings from an on every operation, so an app can switch provider or rotate S3 credentials at runtime (e.g. from an admin settings screen) without a restart. The underlying local/S3 store is cached and rebuilt only when the relevant settings change, so a stable configuration doesn't pay a rebuild cost per call.

member.name: T:KeshavSingh.Storage.IObjectStore
member.summary: Stores opaque binary blobs addressed by a caller-chosen key. Deliberately visibility-agnostic: it knows nothing about who may read a blob or whether it is "public" — access control is the calling app's responsibility. The caller supplies a random, unguessable key (never a client-supplied filename) so the store never has to sanitise paths derived from user input.
